name: Sacred Fist (Legendary Warpriest Archetype)
body:
The most powerful weapon can be the faithful themselves.

Instead of relying upon the weapons and armor to gird them in battle against their foes, the sacred fists eschews such trappings in lieu of greater faith in the protection and power of their faith.

Hands of the Divine: A sacred fist gains the weapon proficiencies of a monk and they gain Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat. Additionally, they deal damage with unarmed strikes as a monk of their class level and gain the ability to perform a flurry of blows as a monk.

This replaces the weapon proficiencies granted by the legendary warpriest and weapons of the faithful.

Girded by Faith (Su)

A sacred fist does not gain any armor or shield proficiency. Instead, if the sacred fist is unarmored and not using a shield, and is carrying less than a medium load, they add their Wisdom bonus to their AC and CMD.

Additionally, at 4th level they gain a +1 dodge bonus to their AC. The dodge bonus increases by 1 for every 4 levels thereafter.

This replaces the armor proficiencies granted by the legendary warpriest.

Ki Pool (Su)

A sacred fist gains the ability to use their fervor as an effective ki pool. Any ability that expends ki or requires a minimum level of remaining ki instead uses the sacred fists’s fervor. The sacred fist also gains the benefits granted to their unarmed strikes from the ki pool as a monk of their class level. Additionally, the sacred fist can as a swift action spend 1 use of fervor to grant themself a +1 insight bonus to their AC for 1 minute. (This is in addition to the normal ki ability to gain a dodge bonus to AC.) This insight bonus increases by 1 for every 3 levels above 7th (to a maximum of +5 at 19th level). This ability replaces the ability for the legendary warpriest to heal allies or harm enemies within a radius with their fervor but it can be combined with archetypes that fully replaces or modifies other parts of the ability, except those that directly modify the radius-based healing.

Divine Styles (Ex)

Beginning at 3rd level, a sacred fist may replace a blessing with a Style Feat of their choice. Their legendary warpriest levels count as monk levels for the purposes of qualifying for the feats.
